title: Black4 founding constitution — verified MFL season choices

options.label: 12-team redraft head-to-head
options.content: Twelve franchises, one division, head-to-head play, each NFL player eligible for one franchise roster; no salaries/contracts, IR or taxi squad. Full-season redraft.

options.label: Gametime locks; owner chooses starters
options.content: Players lock at their scheduled game kickoff. Partial lineups No; best ball No; automatic added-player starters No; Fantasy Sharks Lineup Coach off for every franchise. Never hide starters. Allow bye players Yes. Automatically carry prior lineup at beginning of week; owner may replace unlocked players.

options.label: Snake using exact proposed order
options.content: Use the exact twelve-team teamOrder array in this proposal for round1. MFL S-draft: odd rounds repeat round1, even rounds reverse it. Number of rounds equals selected roster capacity. No random draw after approval.

options.label: 120 second operator target
options.content: Live MFL draft, native timer DISABLED. Target 120 seconds per pick is an operator coordination target only, not an automatic timeout promise. If a franchise stalls, alert commissioner; do not fabricate a pick. Native queue precedence is owner Work List then My Draft List; set empty-list fallback Skip, all automatic-on-clock franchise flags off, no Fantasy Sharks/ADP auto-selection. No skipped pick without explicit handling.

options.label: FAAB with unlocked FCFS
options.content: Blind Bid Requests For Locked Players, First Come/First Serve For Rest. Season FAAB100, minimum0, increment1, nonconditional bids, no FCFS debit, no real-dollar charges, no carryover. No weekly or seasonal acquisition limits. Automatic runs Wed/Thu/Fri/Sat at5amET. Lock free agents Sunday1pmET. Prevent individual-game roster moves from kickoff until week end. Dropped players locked until first waiver run after1day. Existing native processing blackouts apply.

options.content: Receiving owner accepts then commissioner approval required. Invalid-roster trades No; gametime acceptance prevented Yes; future draft picks Not Allowed; proposal expiry7days. Comments remain private.

options.label: 14 regular weeks;6-team playoffs15–17
options.content: Native regular-season schedule1_1_12_14-c: weeks1–14, eight opponents once and three twice, one game per team per week, no doubleheaders. options.label: Winning percentage, points, all-play
options.content: Standings ordered by1 overall winning percentage,2 total points scored,3 all-play winning percentage,4 head-to-head record,5 last weeks point total,6 None. Regular-season ties count as ties. After final regular week and official Thursday stat corrections, commissioner manually seeds the top4 or6 (selected package) in that order via native Manually Seed Playoff Teams. If still exactly tied, earlier position in the owner-approved teamOrder wins the seed; this last step is a transparent commissioner rule, not a claimed native sort option. No auto-seed rule is invented. Non-playoff franchises retain acquisition access through the season end.

questions.label: Score precision, corrections and playoff ties

options.label: Two decimals; official corrections; higher-seed playoff tie
options.content: Calculate weeks1–17 inclusive with2 decimal places; no minimum player/team score, no home-field bonus, no bench points, no extra median matchup. Automatically apply official Thursday morning stat changes. During regular season count tied games as ties; before playoffs commissioner sets native manual-tie mode. A tied playoff matchup advances the higher original seed via native Break Ties after official corrections, with a visible receipt. No arbitrary point fabrication. Bracket advancement is provisional until corrections resolve.
